goal: Audit hardcoded AssumeUTXO snapshot commitments during standard IBD
Crowdsource verification of baked-in snapshot hashes against chain history
agreement: Concept approval for crowdsourced verification during IBD (optout21, Sjors)
Unaddressed objection: shutdown on mismatch acts as an unsafe checkpoint (Sjors)
Unaddressed objection: assertion crash leaves state inconsistent and restart bypasses check (fametrano)
Unaddressed objection: crashing IBD penalizes verified nodes without protecting snapshot users (ajtowns)

categories.name: validation
why: P2 because it crowdsources verification of hardcoded AssumeUTXO snapshot commitments
Closes a trust gap by having every full node validate baked-in hashes against history during IBD
